scripts.build:remote-fs: bun --cwd=apps/core run build:remote-runner && bun --cwd=packages/remote-fs-runner run build
scripts.lint: bun run lint:oxlint && bun run lint:architecture
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --tsconfig tsconfig.json --fix apps packages scripts examples __tests__
scripts.lint:architecture: bun run lint:architecture:semantic && bun run lint:architecture:syntax
scripts.lint:oxlint: oxlint --tsconfig tsconfig.json apps packages scripts examples __tests__
scripts.test:all: bun run test:non-architecture && bun run test:architecture
scripts.test:s3: test -n "$LILAC_BLOB_S3_TEST_ENDPOINT" || { echo 'Set the LILAC_BLOB_S3_TEST_* variables described in DEVELOPMENT.md' >&2; exit 1; }; bun --cwd=packages/blob-storage test ./tests/s3-real-server.test.ts
scripts.test:ci: set -e; bun run test:root -- --only-failures; for dir in apps/* packages/*; do CORE_TEST_PARALLEL=4 bun --cwd="$dir" run test -- --only-failures; done; bun test --only-failures ./scripts/oxlint-plugins/*.test.mts; node --experimental-strip-types scripts/oxlint-plugins/test-waits.rule-test.mts; bun run test:architecture -- --only-failures
scripts.test:non-architecture: bun run test:root && bun run test:workspaces && bun run test:lint-rules
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:workspaces && bun run typecheck:extras
scripts.typecheck:architecture: bunx tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ESNext --module Preserve --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --types bun scripts/architecture/*.ts && bun node_modules/typescript-codegen/bin/tsc -p scripts/architecture/fixtures/stage0/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bun node_modules/typescript-codegen/bin/tsc -p scripts/architecture/fixtures/real-libraries/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.typecheck:codegen: bunx tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ESNext --module Preserve --moduleResolution bundler --types bun scripts/generate-provider-option-shapes.ts
scripts.typecheck:lint-plugins: bunx tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ESNext --module Preserve --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions --types bun scripts/oxlint-plugins/*.mts
scripts.typecheck:extras: bun run --parallel --no-exit-on-error typecheck:root typecheck:codegen typecheck:lint-plugins typecheck:architecture
scripts.docker:build:computer-use: docker build -t lilac-computer:local packages/computer-use-runner && docker build -t lilac-computer-gateway:local -f apps/computer-use-gateway/Dockerfile .
